svg.title: Low-wing light aircraft — Lágvængja flugvél
svg.desc: A frontal low-wing aircraft has broad wings joining below its round fuselage and splayed landing legs.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"aviation-low-wing-plane","label_en":"Low-wing light aircraft","label_is":"Lágvængja flugvél","section":"04","category_en":"Aircraft and flight","category_is":"Loftför og flug","batch":2,"tags":["aviation","aircraft"],"description":"A frontal low-wing aircraft has broad wings joining below its round fuselage and splayed landing legs.","design_note":"The wing roots sit low on the body and lack the high-wing bracing, making this a genuine structural distinction.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
